user.title: HouseLit
user.description:
This turns on HouseLit. Next, open **HouseLit** in the sidebar. On the **Devices** tab, choose **Pair a device** (the **Pair** button). For an iPhone, choose **iPhone** and scan the QR code with it. For a watch, choose **Apple Watch**, then on the watch choose **Pair with Home Assistant** and type the code it shows. On the old 3.0 app (then called Wrist Assistant), sign in to Home Assistant from the iPhone app instead.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

abort.single_instance_allowed: HouseLit is already set up. To add a device, open HouseLit in the sidebar and choose Pair a device on the Devices tab.
